export default "---\ntitle: \"前端持续集成与部署实践\"\nexcerpt: \"深入探讨前端持续集成与部署的实践方案，包括CI/CD流程设计、自动化构建、部署策略等，帮助团队建立高效的开发运维一体化体系\"\ncoverImage: \"/assets/blog/dynamic-routing/cover.jpg\"\ndate: \"2025-12-13\"\nauthor:\n  name: 小羽\n  picture: \"/assets/blog/authors/jj.jpeg\"\nogImage:\n  url: \"/assets/blog/preview/cover.jpg\"\n---\n\n# 前端持续集成与部署实践\n\n## 持续集成与部署概述\n\n### 什么是CI/CD\n\nCI/CD是现代软件开发的核心实践，包括：\n\n1. **持续集成(Continuous Integration, CI)**：开发人员频繁地将代码集成到共享仓库，每次集成都通过自动构建和测试验证\n2. **持续交付(Continuous Delivery)**：确保代码可以随时部署到生产环境\n3. **持续部署(Continuous Deployment)**：自动将通过所有测试的代码部署到生产环境\n\n### CI/CD的价值\n\n1. **提高代码质量**：通过自动化测试和代码检查\n2. **加速交付周期**：自动化构建和部署流程\n3. **降低风险**：小步快跑，减少集成问题\n4. **增强团队协作**：统一的开发流程和标准\n5. **快速反馈**：及时发现问题并修复\n\n### CI/CD流程图\n\n```mermaid\ngraph LR\n    A[开发人员提交代码] --> B[触发CI流水线]\n    B --> C[代码检查]\n    C --> D[单元测试]\n    D --> E[构建应用]\n    E --> F[集成测试]\n    F --> G[构建产物]\n    G --> H{测试通过?}\n    H -->|是| I[部署到测试环境]\n    H -->|否| J[通知开发人员]\n    I --> K[端到端测试]\n    K --> L{测试通过?}\n    L -->|是| M[部署到生产环境]\n    L -->|否| J\n    J --> A\n    M --> N[监控与告警]\n```\n\n## CI/CD工具选择\n\n### 主流CI/CD平台对比\n\n| 平台 | 优点 | 缺点 | 适用场景 |\n|------|------|------|----------|\n| GitHub Actions | 与GitHub深度集成，配置简单 | 执行器资源有限 | 开源项目，GitHub托管项目 |\n| GitLab CI/CD | 功能全面，自托管选项 | 学习曲线较陡 | 企业级应用，需要自托管 |\n| Jenkins | 高度可定制，插件丰富 | 配置复杂，维护成本高 | 复杂构建流程，企业环境 |\n| CircleCI | 配置简单，执行速度快 | 免费额度有限 | 中小型项目，快速迭代 |\n| Travis CI | 配置简单，与GitHub集成好 | 免费版功能有限 | 开源项目 |\n\n### GitHub Actions详解\n\n#### GitHub Actions基础概念\n\n1. **工作流(Workflow)**：定义在`.github/workflows/`目录下的YAML文件\n2. **事件(Event)**：触发工作流运行的活动，如push、pull request\n3. **作业(Job)**：工作流中的执行单元\n4. **步骤(Step)**：作业中的单个任务\n5. **动作(Action)**：可重用的代码单元\n\n#### GitHub Actions配置示例\n\n```yaml\n# .github/workflows/ci-cd.yml\nname: CI/CD Pipeline\n\n# 触发条件\non:\n  push:\n    branches: [ main, develop ]\n  pull_request:\n    branches: [ main ]\n\n# 环境变量\nenv:\n  NODE_VERSION: '16'\n  CACHE_VERSION: 'v1'\n\n# 工作流\njobs:\n  # 代码检查和测试\n  test:\n    name: Test\n    runs-on: ubuntu-latest\n    \n    # 缓存依赖\n    strategy:\n      matrix:\n        node-version: [14, 16, 18]\n    \n    steps:\n    - name: Checkout code\n      uses: actions/checkout@v3\n    \n    - name: Setup Node.js ${{ matrix.node-version }}\n      uses: actions/setup-node@v3\n      with:\n        node-version: ${{ matrix.node-version }}\n        cache: 'npm'\n    \n    - name: Install dependencies\n      run: npm ci\n    \n    - name: Run linter\n      run: npm run lint\n    \n    - name: Run type check\n      run: npm run type-check\n    \n    - name: Run unit tests\n      run: npm run test:unit\n    \n    - name: Run integration tests\n      run: npm run test:integration\n    \n    - name: Upload coverage reports\n      uses: codecov/codecov-action@v3\n      with:\n        file: ./coverage/lcov.info\n        flags: unittests\n        name: codecov-umbrella\n  \n  # 构建应用\n  build:\n    name: Build\n    runs-on: ubuntu-latest\n    needs: test\n    \n    steps:\n    - name: Checkout code\n      uses: actions/checkout@v3\n    \n    - name: Setup Node.js\n      uses: actions/setup-node@v3\n      with:\n        node-version: ${{ env.NODE_VERSION }}\n        cache: 'npm'\n    \n    - name: Install dependencies\n      run: npm ci\n    \n    - name: Build application\n      run: npm run build\n    \n    - name: Upload build artifacts\n      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v3\n      with:\n        name: build-files\n        path: dist/\n        retention-days: 7\n  \n  # 部署到测试环境\n  deploy-staging:\n    name: Deploy to Staging\n    runs-on: ubuntu-latest\n    needs: build\n    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/develop'\n    environment: staging\n    \n    steps:\n    - name: Checkout code\n      uses: actions/checkout@v3\n    \n    - name: Download build artifacts\n      uses: actions/download-artifact@v3\n      with:\n        name: build-files\n        path: dist/\n    \n    - name: Deploy to staging\n      uses: peaceiris/actions-gh-pages@v3\n      with:\n        github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}\n        publish_dir: ./dist\n        destination_dir: staging\n    \n    - name: Run E2E tests\n      run: npm run test:e2e:staging\n  \n  # 部署到生产环境\n  deploy-production:\n    name: Deploy to Production\n    runs-on: ubuntu-latest\n    needs: build\n    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'\n    environment: production\n    \n    steps:\n    - name: Checkout code\n      uses: actions/checkout@v3\n    \n    - name: Download build artifacts\n      uses: actions/download-artifact@v3\n      with:\n        name: build-files\n        path: dist/\n    \n    - name: Deploy to production\n      uses: peaceiris/actions-gh-pages@v3\n      with:\n        github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}\n        publish_dir: ./dist\n        destination_dir: .\n    \n    - name: Notify deployment\n      uses: 8398a7/action-slack@v3\n      with:\n        status: ${{ job.status }}\n        channel: '#deployments'\n        webhook_url: ${{ secrets.SLACK_WEBHOOK }}\n```\n\n#### 自定义GitHub Actions\n\n```yaml\n# .github/workflows/custom-action.yml\nname: Custom Action Demo\n\non:\n  push:\n    branches: [ main ]\n\njobs:\n  use-custom-action:\n    runs-on: ubuntu-latest\n    steps:\n    - name: Checkout code\n      uses: actions/checkout@v3\n    \n    - name: Use custom action\n      uses: ./.github/actions/custom-action\n      with:\n        input-parameter: 'hello-world'\n```\n\n```yaml\n# .github/actions/custom-action/action.yml\nname: 'Custom Action'\ndescription: 'A custom action for demonstration'\ninputs:\n  input-parameter:\n    description: 'An input parameter'\n    required: true\n    default: 'default-value'\noutputs:\n  output-parameter:\n    description: 'An output parameter'\n    value: ${{ steps.step1.outputs.output }}\nruns:\n  using: 'composite'\n  steps:\n    - name: Step 1\n      id: step1\n      shell: bash\n      run: |\n        echo \"Processing input: ${{ inputs.input-parameter }}\"\n        echo \"::set-output name=output::processed-${{ inputs.input-parameter }}\"\n    \n    - name: Step 2\n      shell: bash\n      run: |\n        echo \"Output from step 1: ${{ steps.step1.outputs.output }}\"\n```\n\n## 构建优化策略\n\n### 构建性能优化\n\n#### 依赖缓存\n\n```yaml\n# GitHub Actions中的依赖缓存示例\n- name: Cache node modules\n  uses: actions/cache@v3\n  with:\n    path: |\n      ~/.npm\n      node_modules\n    key: ${{ runner.os }}-node-${{ env.CACHE_VERSION }}-${{ hashFiles('**/package-lock.json') }}\n    restore-keys: |\n      ${{ runner.os }}-node-${{ env.CACHE_VERSION }}-\n      ${{ runner.os }}-node-\n```\n\n#### 并行构建\n\n```yaml\n# 并行执行测试\njobs:\n  test:\n    runs-on: ubuntu-latest\n    strategy:\n      matrix:\n        # 并行运行不同类型的测试\n        test-type: [unit, integration, e2e]\n        # 并行运行不同浏览器测试\n        browser: [chrome, firefox, safari]\n        exclude:\n          # 排除某些组合\n          - test-type: unit\n            browser: safari\n    \n    steps:\n    - name: Run ${{ matrix.test-type }} tests on ${{ matrix.browser }}\n      run: npm run test:${{ matrix.test-type }}:${{ matrix.browser }}\n```\n\n#### 增量构建\n\n```javascript\n// webpack.config.js\nmodule.exports = {\n  // 启用缓存\n  cache: {\n    type: 'filesystem',\n    buildDependencies: {\n      config: [__filename]\n    }\n  },\n  \n  // 代码分割\n  optimization: {\n    splitChunks: {\n      chunks: 'all',\n      cacheGroups: {\n        vendor: {\n          test: /[\\\\/]node_modules[\\\\/]/,\n          name: 'vendors',\n          chunks: 'all'\n        }\n      }\n    }\n  }\n};\n```\n\n### 构建产物优化\n\n#### 代码压缩与优化\n\n```javascript\n// webpack.prod.js\nconst TerserPlugin = require('terser-webpack-plugin');\nconst CssMinimizerPlugin = require('css-minimizer-webpack-plugin');\n\nmodule.exports = {\n  optimization: {\n    minimize: true,\n    minimizer: [\n      new TerserPlugin({\n        parallel: true,\n        terserOptions: {\n          compress: {\n            drop_console: true, // 移除console\n            drop_debugger: true, // 移除debugger\n            pure_funcs: ['console.log'] // 移除特定函数调用\n          }\n        }\n      }),\n      new CssMinimizerPlugin()\n    ]\n  }\n};\n```\n\n#### 资源优化\n\n```javascript\n// 图片优化\nconst ImageMinimizerPlugin = require('image-minimizer-webpack-plugin');\n\nmodule.exports = {\n  plugins: [\n    new ImageMinimizerPlugin({\n      minimizer: {\n        implementation: ImageMinimizerPlugin.imageminMinify,\n        options: {\n          plugins: [\n            ['gifsicle', { optimizationLevel: 7 }],\n            ['mozjpeg', { quality: 80 }],\n            ['pngquant', { quality: [0.65, 0.8] }],\n            ['svgo', { plugins: [{ name: 'removeViewBox', active: false }] }]\n          ]\n        }\n      }\n    })\n  ]\n};\n```\n\n## 部署策略\n\n### 部署环境管理\n\n#### 环境配置\n\n```javascript\n// config/environments.js\nconst environments = {\n  development: {\n    apiUrl: 'http://localhost:3001/api',\n    logLevel: 'debug',\n    enableMockData: true\n  },\n  staging: {\n    apiUrl: 'https://staging-api.example.com/api',\n    logLevel: 'info',\n    enableMockData: false\n  },\n  production: {\n    apiUrl: 'https://api.example.com/api',\n    logLevel: 'error',\n    enableMockData: false\n  }\n};\n\nconst currentEnv = process.env.NODE_ENV || 'development';\nmodule.exports = environments[currentEnv];\n```\n\n#### 环境变量管理\n\n```yaml\n# GitHub Actions中的环境变量\n- name: Setup environment variables\n  run: |\n    echo \"API_URL=${{ secrets.API_URL }}\" >> .env.production\n    echo \"API_KEY=${{ secrets.API_KEY }}\" >> .env.production\n    echo \"SENTRY_DSN=${{ secrets.SENTRY_DSN }}\" >> .env.production\n```\n\n### 部署策略类型\n\n#### 蓝绿部署\n\n蓝绿部署是通过维护两个相同的生产环境（蓝色和绿色）来实现零停机部署的策略。\n\n```yaml\n# 蓝绿部署示例\n- name: Blue-Green Deployment\n  run: |\n    # 检查当前活跃环境\n    CURRENT_ENV=$(curl -s https://api.example.com/health | jq -r '.environment')\n    \n    # 确定目标环境\n    if [ \"$CURRENT_ENV\" = \"blue\" ]; then\n      TARGET_ENV=\"green\"\n    else\n      TARGET_ENV=\"blue\"\n    fi\n    \n    # 部署到目标环境\n    echo \"Deploying to $TARGET_ENV environment\"\n    scp -r dist/ user@${TARGET_ENV}.example.com:/var/www/html/\n    \n    # 健康检查\n    curl -f https://${TARGET_ENV}.example.com/health || exit 1\n    \n    # 切换流量\n    echo \"Switching traffic to $TARGET_ENV\"\n    aws elbv2 modify-listener \\\n      --listener-arn ${{ secrets.LISTENER_ARN }} \\\n      --default-actions Type=forward,TargetGroupArn=${{ secrets.${TARGET_ENV}_TARGET_GROUP_ARN }}\n    \n    echo \"Deployment to $TARGET_ENV completed successfully\"\n```\n\n#### 滚动更新\n\n滚动更新是逐步替换旧版本实例的部署策略。\n\n```yaml\n# 滚动更新示例\n- name: Rolling Update\n  run: |\n    # 获取当前实例列表\n    INSTANCES=$(aws ec2 describe-instances \\\n      --filters \"Name=tag:Environment,Values=production\" \\\n      --query \"Reservations[*].Instances[*].InstanceId\" \\\n      --output text)\n    \n    # 逐个更新实例\n    for INSTANCE in $INSTANCES; do\n      echo \"Updating instance $INSTANCE\"\n      \n      # 从负载均衡器中移除实例\n      aws elbv2 deregister-targets \\\n        --target-group-arn ${{ secrets.TARGET_GROUP_ARN }} \\\n        --targets Id=$INSTANCE\n      \n      # 等待连接排空\n      sleep 30\n      \n      # 部署新版本\n      scp -r dist/ ec2-user@$INSTANCE:/var/www/html/\n      \n      # 健康检查\n      ssh ec2-user@$INSTANCE \"curl -f http://localhost/health\" || exit 1\n      \n      # 重新加入负载均衡器\n      aws elbv2 register-targets \\\n        --target-group-arn ${{ secrets.TARGET_GROUP_ARN }} \\\n        --targets Id=$INSTANCE\n      \n      echo \"Instance $INSTANCE updated successfully\"\n    done\n```\n\n#### 金丝雀发布\n\n金丝雀发布是将新版本先部署给一小部分用户，验证无误后再全量发布。\n\n```yaml\n# 金丝雀发布示例\n- name: Canary Deployment\n  run: |\n    # 部署金丝雀版本\n    echo \"Deploying canary version\"\n    scp -r dist/ user@canary.example.com:/var/www/html/\n    \n    # 配置流量分配（10%到金丝雀版本）\n    echo \"Configuring traffic routing\"\n    aws apigatewayv2 update-route \\\n      --api-id ${{ secrets.API_ID }} \\\n      --route-id ${{ secrets.ROUTE_ID }} \\\n      --target \"canary.example.com\"\n    \n    # 设置权重\n    aws apigatewayv2 update-stage \\\n      --api-id ${{ secrets.API_ID }} \\\n      --stage-name production \\\n      --route-settings '{\"/\": {\"LoggingLevel\": \"INFO\", \"DataTraceEnabled\": true}}'\n    \n    # 等待验证时间\n    echo \"Waiting for validation\"\n    sleep 300\n    \n    # 检查金丝雀版本指标\n    ERROR_RATE=$(aws cloudwatch get-metric-statistics \\\n      --namespace AWS/ApiGateway \\\n      --metric-name 5XXError \\\n      --dimensions Name=ApiId,Value=${{ secrets.API_ID }} \\\n      --start-time $(date -u -v-10M +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ) \\\n      --end-time $(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ) \\\n      --period 60 \\\n      --statistics Average \\\n      --query Datapoints[0].Average)\n    \n    # 如果错误率低于阈值，继续全量发布\n    if (( $(echo \"$ERROR_RATE < 0.01\" | bc -l) )); then\n      echo \"Canary validation passed, proceeding with full rollout\"\n      # 逐步增加流量\n      for WEIGHT in 20 40 60 80 100; do\n        echo \"Increasing traffic to $WEIGHT%\"\n        aws apigatewayv2 update-stage \\\n          --api-id ${{ secrets.API_ID }} \\\n          --stage-name production \\\n          --default-route-settings \"{\\\"ThrottlingBurstLimit\\\": 5000, \\\"ThrottlingRateLimit\\\": 10000, \\\"DetailedMetricsEnabled\\\": true, \\\"LoggingLevel\\\": \\\"INFO\\\", \\\"DataTraceEnabled\\\": true, \\\"CanarySettings\\\": { \\\"PercentTraffic\\\": $WEIGHT }}\"\n        sleep 60\n      done\n    else\n      echo \"Canary validation failed, rolling back\"\n      # 回滚到稳定版本\n      aws apigatewayv2 update-route \\\n        --api-id ${{ secrets.API_ID }} \\\n        --route-id ${{ secrets.ROUTE_ID }} \\\n        --target \"stable.example.com\"\n      exit 1\n    fi\n```\n\n## 监控与告警\n\n### 应用性能监控\n\n#### 前端性能监控\n\n```javascript\n// 性能监控配置\nimport * as Sentry from '@sentry/react';\nimport { BrowserTracing } from '@sentry/tracing';\n\nSentry.init({\n  dsn: process.env.REACT_APP_SENTRY_DSN,\n  integrations: [\n    new BrowserTracing({\n      routingInstrumentation: Sentry.reactRouterV6Instrumentation(\n        React.useEffect,\n        useLocation,\n        useNavigationType,\n        createRoutesFromChildren,\n        matchRoutes\n      ),\n    }),\n  ],\n  tracesSampleRate: 0.1,\n  environment: process.env.NODE_ENV,\n  release: `my-app@${process.env.REACT_APP_VERSION}`\n});\n\n// 自定义性能指标\nconst measurePerformance = (name, fn) => {\n  const start = performance.now();\n  const result = fn();\n  const end = performance.now();\n  Sentry.addBreadcrumb({\n    message: `Performance: ${name}`,\n    level: 'info',\n    data: {\n      duration: end - start\n    }\n  });\n  return result;\n};\n\n// 使用示例\nconst fetchUserData = async (userId) => {\n  return measurePerformance('fetchUserData', async () => {\n    const response = await fetch(`/api/users/${userId}`);\n    return response.json();\n  });\n};\n```\n\n#### 部署监控\n\n```yaml\n# 部署后健康检查\n- name: Post-deployment health check\n  run: |\n    # 等待应用启动\n    sleep 30\n    \n    # 检查健康端点\n    for i in {1..10}; do\n      if curl -f https://example.com/health; then\n        echo \"Health check passed\"\n        break\n      else\n        echo \"Health check failed, retrying... ($i/10)\"\n        sleep 10\n      fi\n    done\n    \n    # 检查关键功能\n    curl -f https://example.com/api/users || exit 1\n    curl -f https://example.com/api/products || exit 1\n    \n    echo \"All health checks passed\"\n```\n\n### 告警配置\n\n#### Slack通知\n\n```yaml\n# Slack通知配置\n- name: Notify Slack on failure\n  if: failure()\n  uses: 8398a7/action-slack@v3\n  with:\n    status: failure\n    channel: '#ci-cd'\n    webhook_url: ${{ secrets.SLACK_WEBHOOK }}\n    fields: repo,message,commit,author,action,eventName,ref,workflow\n\n- name: Notify Slack on success\n  if: success()\n  uses: 8398a7/action-slack@v3\n  with:\n    status: success\n    channel: '#ci-cd'\n    webhook_url: ${{ secrets.SLACK_WEBHOOK }}\n    text: 'Deployment to production completed successfully! 🎉'\n```\n\n#### 邮件通知\n\n```yaml\n# 邮件通知配置\n- name: Send email notification\n  if: always()\n  uses: dawidd6/action-send-mail@v3\n  with:\n    server_address: smtp.gmail.com\n    server_port: 587\n    username: ${{ secrets.EMAIL_USERNAME }}\n    password: ${{ secrets.EMAIL_PASSWORD }}\n    subject: \"Deployment ${{ job.status }}: ${{ github.repository }}\"\n    body: |\n      Deployment Status: ${{ job.status }}\n      Repository: ${{ github.repository }}\n      Branch: ${{ github.ref }}\n      Commit: ${{ github.sha }}\n      Actor: ${{ github.actor }}\n    to: ${{ secrets.NOTIFICATION_EMAIL }}\n    from: GitHub Actions\n```\n\n## 实际应用案例\n\n### 大型电商平台CI/CD流程\n\n以下是一个大型电商平台的CI/CD实施案例：\n\n#### 1. 整体架构\n\n```mermaid\ngraph TD\n    A[开发人员] --> B[Git Push]\n    B --> C[GitHub Actions]\n    C --> D[代码检查]\n    D --> E[单元测试]\n    E --> F[构建应用]\n    F --> G[安全扫描]\n    G --> H[部署到测试环境]\n    H --> I[集成测试]\n    I --> J[性能测试]\n    J --> K[部署到预生产环境]\n    K --> L[用户验收测试]\n    L --> M{批准发布?}\n    M -->|是| N[蓝绿部署到生产环境]\n    M -->|否| O[回滚]\n    N --> P[监控与告警]\n    O --> Q[修复问题]\n    Q --> B\n```\n\n#### 2. CI/CD配置\n\n```yaml\n# .github/workflows/ecommerce-pipeline.yml\nname: E-commerce CI/CD Pipeline\n\non:\n  push:\n    branches: [ main, develop, 'release/*' ]\n  pull_request:\n    branches: [ main ]\n\nenv:\n  REGISTRY: ghcr.io\n  IMAGE_NAME: ${{ github.repository }}\n\njobs:\n  # 代码质量检查\n  quality-check:\n    name: Quality Check\n    runs-on: ubuntu-latest\n    \n    steps:\n    - name: Checkout code\n      uses: actions/checkout@v3\n    \n    - name: Setup Node.js\n      uses: actions/setup-node@v3\n      with:\n        node-version: '16'\n        cache: 'npm'\n    \n    - name: Install dependencies\n      run: npm ci\n    \n    - name: Run ESLint\n      run: npm run lint\n    \n    - name: Run Prettier check\n      run: npm run format:check\n    \n    - name: Run TypeScript check\n      run: npm run type-check\n    \n    - name: Run unit tests\n      run: npm run test:unit -- --coverage\n    \n    - name: Upload coverage to Codecov\n      uses: codecov/codecov-action@v3\n  \n  # 安全扫描\n  security-scan:\n    name: Security Scan\n    runs-on: ubuntu-latest\n    needs: quality-check\n    \n    steps:\n    - name: Checkout code\n      uses: actions/checkout@v3\n    \n    - name: Run npm audit\n      run: npm audit --audit-level moderate\n    \n    - name: Run Snyk security scan\n      uses: snyk/actions/node@master\n      env:\n        SNYK_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SNYK_TOKEN }}\n      with:\n        args: --severity-threshold=high\n  \n  # 构建Docker镜像\n  build-image:\n    name: Build Docker Image\n    runs-on: ubuntu-latest\n    needs: [quality-check, security-scan]\n    if: github.event_name == 'push'\n    \n    outputs:\n      image-digest: ${{ steps.build.outputs.digest }}\n      image-tag: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.tags }}\n    \n    steps:\n    - name: Checkout code\n      uses: actions/checkout@v3\n    \n    - name: Set up Docker Buildx\n      uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v2\n    \n    - name: Log in to Container Registry\n      uses: docker/login-action@v2\n      with:\n        registry: ${{ env.REGISTRY }}\n        username: ${{ github.actor }}\n        password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}\n    \n    - name: Extract metadata\n      id: meta\n      uses: docker/metadata-action@v4\n      with:\n        images: ${{ env.REGISTRY }}/${{ env.IMAGE_NAME }}\n        tags: |\n          type=ref,event=branch\n          type=ref,event=pr\n          type=sha,prefix={{branch}}-\n          type=raw,value=latest,enable={{is_default_branch}}\n    \n    - name: Build and push Docker image\n      id: build\n      uses: docker/build-push-action@v4\n      with:\n        context: .\n        push: true\n        tags: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.tags }}\n        labels: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.labels }}\n        cache-from: type=gha\n        cache-to: type=gha,mode=max\n  \n  # 部署到测试环境\n  deploy-staging:\n    name: Deploy to Staging\n    runs-on: ubuntu-latest\n    needs: build-image\n    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/develop'\n    environment: staging\n    \n    steps:\n    - name: Checkout code\n      uses: actions/checkout@v3\n    \n    - name: Deploy to Kubernetes\n      run: |\n        echo \"${{ secrets.KUBE_CONFIG }}\" | base64 -d > kubeconfig\n        export KUBECONFIG=kubeconfig\n        \n        # 更新镜像标签\n        sed -i \"s|image: .*|image: ${{ needs.build-image.outputs.image-tag }}|g\" k8s/staging/deployment.yaml\n        \n        # 应用配置\n        kubectl apply -f k8s/staging/\n        \n        # 等待部署完成\n        kubectl rollout status deployment/ecommerce-staging -n staging\n    \n    - name: Run integration tests\n      run: |\n        npm run test:integration:staging\n    \n    - name: Run performance tests\n      run: |\n        npm run test:performance:staging\n  \n  # 部署到预生产环境\n  deploy-preprod:\n    name: Deploy to Pre-production\n    runs-on: ubuntu-latest\n    needs: build-image\n    if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/heads/release/')\n    environment: pre-production\n    \n    steps:\n    - name: Checkout code\n      uses: actions/checkout@v3\n    \n    - name: Deploy to Kubernetes\n      run: |\n        echo \"${{ secrets.KUBE_CONFIG }}\" | base64 -d > kubeconfig\n        export KUBECONFIG=kubeconfig\n        \n        # 更新镜像标签\n        sed -i \"s|image: .*|image: ${{ needs.build-image.outputs.image-tag }}|g\" k8s/preprod/deployment.yaml\n        \n        # 应用配置\n        kubectl apply -f k8s/preprod/\n        \n        # 等待部署完成\n        kubectl rollout status deployment/ecommerce-preprod -n preprod\n    \n    - name: Run E2E tests\n      run: |\n        npm run test:e2e:preprod\n  \n  # 部署到生产环境\n  deploy-production:\n    name: Deploy to Production\n    runs-on: ubuntu-latest\n    needs: build-image\n    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'\n    environment: production\n    \n    steps:\n    - name: Checkout code\n      uses: actions/checkout@v3\n    \n    - name: Blue-Green Deployment\n      run: |\n        echo \"${{ secrets.KUBE_CONFIG }}\" | base64 -d > kubeconfig\n        export KUBECONFIG=kubeconfig\n        \n        # 确定当前活跃环境\n        CURRENT_SERVICE=$(kubectl get service ecommerce-prod -n production -o jsonpath='{.spec.selector.version}')\n        \n        if [ \"$CURRENT_SERVICE\" = \"blue\" ]; then\n          TARGET_VERSION=\"green\"\n        else\n          TARGET_VERSION=\"blue\"\n        fi\n        \n        echo \"Deploying to $TARGET_VERSION environment\"\n        \n        # 更新镜像标签\n        sed -i \"s|image: .*|image: ${{ needs.build-image.outputs.image-tag }}|g\" k8s/production/deployment-$TARGET_VERSION.yaml\n        sed -i \"s|version: .*|version: $TARGET_VERSION|g\" k8s/production/deployment-$TARGET_VERSION.yaml\n        \n        # 应用配置\n        kubectl apply -f k8s/production/deployment-$TARGET_VERSION.yaml\n        \n        # 等待部署完成\n        kubectl rollout status deployment/ecommerce-$TARGET_VERSION -n production\n        \n        # 健康检查\n        kubectl wait --for=condition=ready pod -l version=$TARGET_VERSION -n production --timeout=300s\n        \n        # 切换流量\n        kubectl patch service ecommerce-prod -n production -p '{\"spec\":{\"selector\":{\"version\":\"'$TARGET_VERSION'\"}}}'\n        \n        echo \"Traffic switched to $TARGET_VERSION environment\"\n    \n    - name: Post-deployment verification\n      run: |\n        # 等待流量切换\n        sleep 30\n        \n        # 健康检查\n        for i in {1..10}; do\n          if curl -f https://ecommerce.example.com/health; then\n            echo \"Health check passed\"\n            break\n          else\n            echo \"Health check failed, retrying... ($i/10)\"\n            sleep 10\n          fi\n        done\n        \n        # 关键功能检查\n        curl -f https://ecommerce.example.com/api/products || exit 1\n        curl -f https://ecommerce.example.com/api/categories || exit 1\n    \n    - name: Notify deployment\n      uses: 8398a7/action-slack@v3\n      with:\n        status: ${{ job.status }}\n        channel: '#deployments'\n        webhook_url: ${{ secrets.SLACK_WEBHOOK }}\n        text: 'E-commerce platform deployed to production successfully! 🛒'\n```\n\n#### 3. 监控与告警配置\n\n```yaml\n# 监控配置\n- name: Setup monitoring\n  run: |\n    # 配置Prometheus监控\n    kubectl apply -f monitoring/\n    \n    # 配置Grafana仪表板\n    kubectl apply -f dashboards/\n    \n    # 配置告警规则\n    kubectl apply -f alerts/\n\n# 告警配置\n- name: Configure alerts\n  run: |\n    # 创建PrometheusRule\n    cat <<EOF | kubectl apply -f -\n    apiVersion: monitoring.coreos.com/v1\n    kind: PrometheusRule\n    metadata:\n      name: ecommerce-alerts\n      namespace: monitoring\n    spec:\n      groups:\n      - name: ecommerce.rules\n        rules:\n        - alert: HighErrorRate\n          expr: rate(http_requests_total{status=~\"5..\"}[5m]) > 0.01\n          for: 5m\n          labels:\n            severity: critical\n          annotations:\n            summary: \"High error rate detected\"\n            description: \"Error rate is {{ $value }} errors per second\"\n        - alert: HighResponseTime\n          expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) > 0.5\n          for: 5m\n          labels:\n            severity: warning\n          annotations:\n            summary: \"High response time detected\"\n            description: \"95th percentile response time is {{ $value }} seconds\"\n    EOF\n```\n\n## 总结\n\n前端持续集成与部署是现代前端工程化的核心实践，通过自动化工具链可以：\n\n1. **提高开发效率**：自动化构建、测试和部署流程\n2. **保证代码质量**：通过自动化测试和代码检查\n3. **降低部署风险**：通过渐进式部署策略和回滚机制\n4. **加速交付周期**：减少手动操作和等待时间\n5. **增强系统可靠性**：通过监控和告警及时发现问题\n\n有效的CI/CD实践应该：\n- 根据项目需求选择合适的工具和平台\n- 设计合理的流水线阶段和检查点\n- 实施适当的部署策略（蓝绿部署、滚动更新、金丝雀发布）\n- 建立完善的监控和告警机制\n- 持续优化和改进流程\n\n通过持续实践和改进，团队可以建立起高效、可靠的CI/CD流程，为快速迭代和高质量交付提供坚实保障。"
